verdict.rationale: Running a UI framework headlessly is a fair axis. SolidJS's own docs say it has full SSR and serverless support and can render components on the server, so it does execute without a browser. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines, headless test rendering, or automation workflows specifically. Missing for 10: documented CI/automation usage, a headless testing/rendering harness, a non-interactive CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration.
